A girls’ night with movement, music & connection. Join us at Bridge & Bloom for a 60-minute DropSound headphone Buti Yoga experience followe

About this Event

Come move, sweat, shake & BLOOM with us! 🌸🎧
Join Bridge & Bloom Women’s Club + DropSound for a special girls’ night combining movement, music and community.
We’ll start with 60 minutes of Buti Yoga using DropSound wireless headphones—an energizing blend of yoga, movement and music designed to get you out of your head and back into your body.
After class, we’ll slow things down for a Sip & Social with drinks, small bites and time to connect.

Wednesday, October 15
Doors: 6:15 PM
Class: 6:30 PM
Sip & Social immediately following
Tickets: $25 per person

Come for the Buti. Stay for the Bloom. 🌸

What to bring: Yoga mat, water and comfortable clothes you can move in.

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Pittsburgh, Workshops in Pittsburgh.
